context: A teen tells her aunt about a first date
purpose: Teach: まずい/済む/貼り/カタログ/デート/ガソリン/返す/願う

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: なおこ叔母さん、聞いて！昨日、初デートだったの。
lines.en: Aunt Naoko, listen! Yesterday was my first date.
lines.style: Excited teen voice bursting with news, rising pitch on デート, slight giggle.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: えっ、本当に？相手はどんな子なの？ちゃんと話して。
lines.en: What, really? What kind of boy is he? Tell me properly.
lines.style: Warm aunt tone, leaning forward with curious affection, gentle teasing smile.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: それがね、彼が選んだお店の料理がまずいの！もう最悪だった。
lines.en: So, the food at the place he picked was bad! It was the worst.
lines.style: Dramatic teen complaint, exaggerated frown, voice cracking with mock despair.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: あらあら、それは可哀想に。でも、笑って済むなら良かったじゃない。
lines.en: Oh dear, that's a shame. But if you can laugh it off, that's fine.
lines.style: Soothing maternal chuckle, calm reassuring cadence, slightly amused undertone.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: しかも車のガソリンが切れそうで、途中で慌ててたんだよ。
lines.en: And on top of that the car was running out of gas, he panicked midway.
lines.style: Animated storytelling, hands waving, voice quickening with disbelief and humor.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: まあ、初々しいわね。次のデートのプランは決まってるの？
lines.en: My, how charmingly naive. Has the next date plan been decided?
lines.style: Teasing aunt warmth, slow knowing delivery, eyebrows raised playfully.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 壁に貼り出されてたカタログを見て、今度は水族館に行こうって言ってた。
lines.en: Looking at a catalog put up on the wall, he said next time let's go to the aquarium.
lines.style: Softening voice, shy smile creeping in, fingers fidgeting with phone case.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: いいじゃない。今度はあなたがガソリン代を出してあげて、笑顔を返すくらいの余裕を見せなさいね。
lines.en: How nice. Next time you cover the gas money, and show enough composure to give him a smile back.
lines.style: Sincere aunt advice, voice softening with playful warmth, motherly nudging tone.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: うん、次こそ楽しいデートになるように願うよ。
lines.en: Yeah, I really hope the next date turns out fun.
lines.style: Hopeful teen sigh, dreamy upward gaze, voice trailing into a soft smile.
